title: Why You Drive on Autopilot Without Thinking
hook: Your brain performs a magic trick every time you drive a familiar route.

narration.text: Your brain performs a magic trick every time you drive a familiar route.
You arrive at your destination with little memory of the journey.
This is thanks to your basal ganglia, a part of your brain.
It stores routines, like brushing teeth or driving familiar routes.
These become automatic, freeing up your conscious mind.
It means you can think about other things while driving.
This saves your brain energy for new or unexpected situations.
It is also why breaking a routine can feel so difficult.
Have you ever missed an exit because you were on autopilot?

description: Ever wonder why you sometimes arrive at a familiar destination with no memory of the drive? It is not magic, it is your brain's incredible efficiency at work. This video explains the brain science behind 'autopilot' driving.
topic: Why you can drive a familiar route without consciously thinking about every turn.
